## Related

<h3 id="json-token-kind"><code>JsonTokenKind</code></h3>

```rux
pub enum JsonTokenKind: int32 {
    End = 0,
    ObjectStart = 1,
    ObjectEnd = 2,
    ArrayStart = 3,
    ArrayEnd = 4,
    Colon = 5,
    Comma = 6,
    Text = 7,
    Number = 8,
    True = 9,
    False = 10,
    Null = 11,
    Error = 12
}
```

What kind of token this is.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Json/Src/Lexer.rux#L16)

**Cases**

| Name          | Value | Description                                              |
| ------------- | ----- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `End`         | `0`   | The input is exhausted.                                  |
| `ObjectStart` | `1`   | `{`                                                      |
| `ObjectEnd`   | `2`   | `}`                                                      |
| `ArrayStart`  | `3`   | `[`                                                      |
| `ArrayEnd`    | `4`   | `]`                                                      |
| `Colon`       | `5`   | `:`                                                      |
| `Comma`       | `6`   | `,`                                                      |
| `Text`        | `7`   | A string, whose span excludes the quotes.                |
| `Number`      | `8`   | A number, whose span is its whole text.                  |
| `True`        | `9`   | `true`                                                   |
| `False`       | `10`  | `false`                                                  |
| `Null`        | `11`  | `null`                                                   |
| `Error`       | `12`  | Something that is not JSON, or a limit that was reached. |

<h3 id="json-lex-error"><code>JsonLexError</code></h3>

```rux
pub enum JsonLexError: int32 {
    None = 0,
    UnexpectedByte = 1,
    UnterminatedText = 2,
    BadEscape = 3,
    BadUnicodeEscape = 4,
    MalformedNumber = 5,
    InvalidUtf8 = 6,
    UnescapedControl = 7,
    TooManyBytes = 8,
    TextTooLong = 9,
    TooDeep = 10,
    TooManyEntries = 11
}
```

Why lexing stopped.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Json/Src/Lexer.rux#L47)

**Cases**

| Name               | Value | Description                                                                  |
| ------------------ | ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `None`             | `0`   | Nothing went wrong.                                                          |
| `UnexpectedByte`   | `1`   | A byte that begins no token.                                                 |
| `UnterminatedText` | `2`   | A string that the input ended before closing.                                |
| `BadEscape`        | `3`   | An escape sequence JSON does not define.                                     |
| `BadUnicodeEscape` | `4`   | A `\u` escape that is not four hexadecimal digits.                           |
| `MalformedNumber`  | `5`   | A number whose shape JSON's grammar does not allow.                          |
| `InvalidUtf8`      | `6`   | Bytes that are not well-formed UTF-8.                                        |
| `UnescapedControl` | `7`   | A control character appearing unescaped inside a string, which JSON forbids. |
| `TooManyBytes`     | `8`   | The document is longer than the configured limit.                            |
| `TextTooLong`      | `9`   | A string is longer than the configured limit.                                |
| `TooDeep`          | `10`  | Containers are nested deeper than the configured limit.                      |
| `TooManyEntries`   | `11`  | A container holds more entries than the configured limit.                    |

<h3 id="json-token"><code>JsonToken</code></h3>

```rux
pub struct JsonToken {
    pub kind: JsonTokenKind;
    pub start: uint;
    pub end: uint;
    pub escaped: bool;
    pub error: JsonLexError;
}
```

One token, and where in the input it came from.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Json/Src/Lexer.rux#L120)

**Fields**

| Name      | Type            | Description                                                                                                                                                                           |
| --------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`    | `JsonTokenKind` | What kind of token this is.                                                                                                                                                           |
| `start`   | `uint`          | Where its text starts, as a byte offset into the input.                                                                                                                               |
| `end`     | `uint`          | Where its text ends.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `escaped` | `bool`          | For a string, whether it contains any escape that must be resolved. A string without one can be used directly from the input, which is what keeps ordinary documents free of copying. |
| `error`   | `JsonLexError`  | Why lexing stopped, when the kind is `Error`.                                                                                                                                         |
